scope: Proposition 8.2 (Hypersurface equality) of the manuscript “The ordinary-double-point gap in every dimension” (preprints/The-ordinary-double-point-gap-in-every-dimension-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 037 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e2cdac4857afef7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If x ∈ X is a singular klt hypersurface germ of dimension n ≥ 2, then ˆ vol(x, X) ≤ 2(n − 1)n . If equality holds, the quadratic part of a local equation is nondegenerate, and (X, x) is analytically an ordinary double point.
